verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a hosted remote MCP server (AgentOS MCP at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp, OAuth-gated) plus a Developer MCP for sandbox/docs, with concrete connection instructions for clients like Claude Code, and this was independently probed live returning the expected OAuth challenge confirming a real running server. Missing for 10: broader independent third-party usage reports beyond the single probe confirming real-world agent connections.
